_comment: Source of truth for the built-in service icons. Regenerate with `make service-icons`.
The map key is the SERVICE TEMPLATE KEY, and the generated file is named after it
(google_calendar.svg, not googlecalendar.svg). That is what lets a template omit
`icon:` entirely and still resolve to `builtin:<key>` — see DECISIONS.md.
simple-icons:<slug>  copied from the pinned simple-icons package; owner/guidelines
metadata is read from the package and folded into NOTICE.md
pending              no asset shipped. The template falls back to the letter tile.
Requires `owner`, `guidelines` and `note` so the gap is legible.

deepwiki.note: Generic wiki glyph authored by us. DeepWiki has no mark in simple-icons and we do not ship theirs.

email.note: Generic envelope glyph authored by us. Not a vendor mark.

eventbrite.note: No simple-icons entry. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.
